digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command registration
propositions: Advanced command grammars across bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, and identity subsystems are currently defined inline with manual dispatch and must be extracted into reusable S2a-compliant factory functions

Parser factories must be constructible in environments with no optional runtime imports (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing) while preserving all handler-specific capabilities

Parse-failure handling must be reconciled: RebarArgumentParser.error() raises ParseError instead of SystemExit(2), requiring migration of catch-blocks in bridge_commands and trusted_env_cmd to reproduce identical exit codes and stderr

Commands with bespoke presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must preserve byte-identical --help output by extending the S2a factory with optional keyword passthroughs for formatter_class, usage, and add_help
All advanced routes must be registered with valid factory references and proven deterministically generation-ready without handler execution or heavy optional module imports
Nested command selection, aliases, lean modes, backend timing, diagnostics, streams, and exit codes remain invariant across the migration
